engraved.block: Richly detailed engraved antique nautical chart style, like a fine sea chart printed in two inks: many layers of fine lines and hatching, line density increasing in the darker areas to give depth and tone, lines of several weights, crisp and sharp, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant.

line.block: Simple line icon style: one uniform stroke width, rounded caps and joins, no shading, no hatching, no fill, no texture, bold and clear enough to read at 24 pixels, generous empty margin around each icon, a single ink colour.
